name: worktrunk
description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
one_liner: A command-line helper that lets a developer run several AI coding agents on the same project at once without them tripping over each other's files.
buyer: An engineering manager at a startup running multiple AI coding agents in parallel who needs their setup standardized across the team.
business_use_cases: A dev-tooling consultancy sets this up as part of an 'AI-agent workflow audit' package for engineering teams scaling up agent usage.
A platform team at a mid-size company adopts it internally and writes an internal wrapper/training as a side consulting offering to other companies.
A YouTube/course creator builds a paid 'parallel AI coding workflows' course using this as the centerpiece tool.

money_ideas.idea: Paid workshop or course teaching teams how to run many AI coding agents productively.
Consulting retainer helping engineering orgs set up and maintain their agent-parallel dev workflow.

steal_this: This is a free CLI for developers, by developers — honestly, the fastest 'business' here is a one-off paid Loom/course walking teams through setting it up, not a product of your own.
